subject: Multiple counts of a single transect

messages.author: 2f9aa076b11f4a68
messages.subject: Multiple counts of a single transect
parts:
I have conducted line transect surveys using distance bands for some
ongoing research. Each of the transects in the study was counted 4
times. Now, my question is essentially a data handling question.

How should the observations from multiple counts be managed before bringing
them into Distance? Should the data for individual species in each band be
summed, averaged, or perhaps take the maximum count of that species for an
individual band over the 4 separate counts? It would seem that summing
them would produce a problem in that you are almost certainly counting
individuals more than once.

Perhaps I am missing something but would appreciate any help I can
get. Feel free to respond to me personally or to the list. Thanks,

Greg Smith
